deadline.quote: Graduate Admission Application Deadlines: | Domestic applicants: November 15th International Applicants: October 15th

gre_general.value: All applicants are required to submit official GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: All applicants are required to submit official GRE, and official TOEFL or IELTS score results to the University of Georgia, Graduate Admissions office at gradadm@uga.edu.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Computer Science subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Pre-application supervisor agreement is not stated as required.

funding.value: Accepted doctoral students have priority departmental funding in the form of Teaching or Research Assistantships.
funding.quote: *Accepted Doctoral students have priority departmental funding in the form of Teaching or Research Assistantships.

entry_route.value: Direct admission from four-year bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: A four-year bachelor’s degree, a three-year bachelor’s plus a master’s degree, or a three-year bachelor’s plus completion of first year of the master’s program from a recognized institution by the Association of Indian University (AIU) or All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).

fee_waiver.value: School of Computing does not provide graduate application fee waivers.
fee_waiver.quote: NOTE: We DO NOT provide Graduate Application Fee waiver. All applicants are required to pay application fee for admission.
